```
['run the MeshRCNN demo on an input image and save 3D mesh predictions to an output directory', 'create a VisualizationDemo instance with a config, optional highest-scoring-only mode, and an output directory', 'run 3D mesh prediction on a BGR image and save visualized masks and OBJ mesh files', 'visualize a single detection by overlaying its mask, bounding box, label, and saving the mesh as OBJ', 'build and freeze a MeshRCNN config from a YAML file and optional command-line override options']

```
